73389-miss-con.title: Miss Con

73389-miss-con.description: A book by Agnes Giberne. "THE very thing for you, Constance. Really, if we had—a—if we had hunted all England over, we could not—ahem—could not have hoped to find anything more suitable. Positively, it is, if I may so say—if I may venture to use a somewhat time-worn illustration—the fitting of a round man into a round hole,—a round woman, I should rather say,—ha, ha!

arxiv-1807-05522.title: The first constraint from SDSS galaxy-galaxy weak lensing measurements on interacting dark energy models
arxiv-1807-05522.creator: Jiajun Zhang, Rui An, Wentao Luo, Zhaozhou Li, Shihong Liao, Bin Wang
arxiv-1807-05522.description: Abstract We combine constraints from linear and nonlinear scales, for the first time, to study the interaction between dark matter and dark energy. We devise a novel N-body simulation pipeline for cosmological models beyond Λ \Lambda CDM. This pipeline is fully self-consistent and opens a new window to study the nonlinear structure formation in general phenomenological interacting dark energy models.

arxiv-2106-11548.title: Adaptive Learning Rate and Momentum for Training Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2106-11548.creator: Zhiyong Hao, Yixuan Jiang, Huihua Yu, Hsiao-Dong Chiang
arxiv-2106-11548.description: Abstract Recent progress on deep learning relies heavily on the quality and efficiency of training algorithms. In this paper, we develop a fast training method motivated by the nonlinear Conjugate Gradient (CG) framework. We propose the Conjugate Gradient with Quadratic line-search (CGQ) method. On the one hand, a quadratic line-search determines the step size according to current loss landscape.

arxiv-2109-13242.title: Neutrino Echos following Black Hole Formation in Core-Collapse Supernovae GR1D ( O’Connor & Ott 2010 ; O’Connor 2015 ) , NuLib ( O’Connor 2015 ) , SedonuGR ( Richers et al. 2015 ; Richers et al. 2017 ) , SNEWPY ( Baxter et al. 2021 ) , SNOwGLoBES ( Scholberg et al. 2021 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007
arxiv-2109-13242.creator: Samuel Gullin, Evan P. O’Connor, Jia-Shian Wang, Jeff Tseng
arxiv-2109-13242.description: Abstract During a failed core-collapse supernova, the protoneutron star eventually collapses under its own gravitational field and forms a black hole. This collapse happens quickly, on the dynamical time of the protoneutron star, ≲ \lesssim 0.5 ms. During this collapse, barring any excessive rotation, the entire protoneutron star is accreted into the newly formed black hole.

arxiv-2112-00826.creator: Atticus Geiger, Zhengxuan Wu, Hanson Lu, Josh Rozner, Elisa Kreiss, Thomas Icard, Noah D. Goodman, Christopher Potts
arxiv-2112-00826.description: Abstract In many areas, we have well-founded insights about causal structure that would be useful to bring into our trained models while still allowing them to learn in a data-driven fashion. arxiv-2207-05309.title: Quantum Algorithm based on Quantum Fourier Transform for Register-by-Constant Addition
arxiv-2207-05309.creator: Filipe Chagas Ferraz
arxiv-2207-05309.description: Abstract Since Shor’s [ 8 ] proposition of the method for factoring products of prime numbers using quantum computing, there has been a quest to implement efficient quantum arithmetic algorithms. These algorithms are capable of applying arithmetic operations simultaneously on large sets of values using quantum parallelism.

arxiv-2305-08323.title: Approximation and Progressive Display of Multiverse Analyses
arxiv-2305-08323.creator: Yang Liu, Tim Althoff, and Jeffrey Heer
arxiv-2305-08323.description: Abstract A multiverse analysis evaluates all combinations of “reasonable” analytic decisions to promote robustness and transparency, but can lead to a combinatorial explosion of analyses to compute. Long delays before assessing results prevent users from diagnosing errors and iterating early.

arxiv-2407-14312.title: Flares from plasmoids and current sheets around Sgr A*
arxiv-2407-14312.creator: I. Dimitropoulos, A. Nathanail, M. Petropoulou, I. Contopoulos, C. M. Fromm
arxiv-2407-14312.description: Abstract Context. The supermassive black hole Sgr A* at the center of our galaxy produces repeating near-infrared flares that are observed by ground and space based instruments. This activity has been simulated in the past with Magnetically Arrested Disk (MAD) models which include stable jet formations.

arxiv-2408-02460.title: Fast Robust Monitoring for Signal Temporal Logic with Value Freezing Operators ( STL​ ∗ )
arxiv-2408-02460.creator: Bassem Ghorbel, Vinayak S. Prabhu
arxiv-2408-02460.description: Abstract Researchers have previously proposed augmenting Signal Temporal Logic (STL) with the value freezing operator in order to express engineering properties that cannot be expressed in STL. This augmented logic is known as STL​ ∗ . The previous algorithms for STL​ ∗ monitoring were intractable, and did not scale formulae with nested freeze variables.

arxiv-2501-09304.title: Finding the Trigger: Causal Abductive Reasoning on Video Events
arxiv-2501-09304.creator: Thao Minh Le, Vuong Le, Kien Do, Sunil Gupta, Svetha Venkatesh, Truyen Tran
arxiv-2501-09304.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Thao Minh Le, Vuong Le, Kien Do, Sunil Gupta, Svetha Venkatesh, Truyen Tran. This paper introduces a new problem, Causal Abductive Reasoning on Video Events (CARVE), which involves identifying causal relationships between events in a video and generating hypotheses about causal chains that account for the occurrence of a target event. To facilitate research in this direction, we create two new benchmark datasets with both synthetic and realistic videos, accompanied by trigger-target labels generated through a novel counterfactual synthesis approach.

arxiv-2502-12255.title: The past, present and future of observations of externally irradiated disks
arxiv-2502-12255.creator: Planet formation environments collaboration, Megan Allen 1, Rossella Anania 2, Morten Andersen 3, Mari-Liis Aru 3, Giulia Ballabio 4, Nicholas P. Ballering 5,6, Giacomo Beccari 3, Olivier Berné 7, Arjan Bik 8, Ryan D. Boyden 6, Gavin Coleman 9, Javiera Díaz-Berrios 10, Joseph W. Eatson 1, Jenny Fred
arxiv-2502-12255.description: Abstract Recent years have seen a surge of interest in the community studying the effect of ultraviolet radiation environment, predominantly set by OB stars, on protoplanetary disc evolution and planet formation. This is important because a significant fraction of planetary systems, potentially including our own, formed in close proximity to OB stars.

arxiv-2505-01397.title: Bridging the Atmospheric Circulations of Hot and Warm Giant Exoplanets
arxiv-2505-01397.creator: J. W. Skinner †,, S. Wei
arxiv-2505-01397.description: Abstract We perform high-resolution atmospheric flow simulations of hot and warm giant exoplanets that are tidally locked. The modeled atmospheres are representative of those on KELT-11 b and WASP-39 b ​, which possess markedly different equilibrium temperatures but reside in a similar dynamical regime: in this regime, their key dynamical numbers (e.g., Rossby and Froude numbers) are comparable.

arxiv-2507-21133.title: Analysis of Threat-Based Manipulation in Large Language Models: A Dual Perspective on Vulnerabilities and Performance Enhancement Opportunities
arxiv-2507-21133.creator: Atil Samancioglu
arxiv-2507-21133.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate complex responses to threat-based manipulations, revealing both vulnerabilities and unexpected performance enhancement opportunities. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of 3,390 experimental responses from three major LLMs (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) across 10 task domains under 6 threat conditions.

pmc-10646233.title: Btg2 Promotes Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis via Smad3‐Dependent Podocyte‐Mesenchymal Transition
pmc-10646233.creator: Qiong‐ Dan Hu, Hong‐Lian Wang, Jian Liu, Tao He, Rui‐Zhi Tan, Qiong Zhang, Hong‐Wei Su, Fahsai Kantawong, Hui‐Yao Lan, Li Wang
pmc-10646233.description: Podocyte injury plays a critical role in the progression of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS). Here, it is reported that B‐cell translocation gene 2 (Btg2) promotes Adriamycin (ADR)‐induced FSGS via Smad3‐dependent podocyte‐mesenchymal transition. It is found that in FSGS patients and animal models, Btg2 is markedly upregulated by podocytes and correlated with progressive renal injury.

pmc-11325023.title: Induction of trained immunity in broiler chickens following delivery of oligodeoxynucleotide containing CpG motifs to protect against Escherichia coli septicemia
pmc-11325023.creator: Iresha Subhasinghe, Khawaja Ashfaque Ahmed, Lisanework E. Ayalew, Hemlata Gautam, Shelly Popowich, Ayumi Matsuyama-Kato, Betty Chow-Lockerbie, Suresh K. Tikoo, Philip Griebel, Susantha Gomis
pmc-11325023.description: Oligodeoxynucleotides containing CpG motifs (CpG-ODN) can promote antimicrobial immunity in chickens by enriching immune compartments and activating immune cells. Innate memory, or trained immunity, has been demonstrated in humans and mice, featuring the absence of specificity to the initial stimulus and subsequently cross-protection against pathogens. We hypothesize that CpG-ODN can induce trained immunity in chickens.

pmc-11464601.title: Unsupervised domain adaptation for remote sensing semantic segmentation with the 2D discrete wavelet transform
pmc-11464601.creator: Junying Zeng, Yajin Gu, Chuanbo Qin, Xudong Jia, Senyao Deng, Jiahua Xu, Huiming Tian
pmc-11464601.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). There would be the differences in spectra, scale and resolution between the Remote Sensing datasets of the source and target domains, which would lead to the degradation of the cross-domain segmentation performance of the model. Image transfer faced two problems in the process of domain-adaptive learning: overly focusing on style features while ignoring semantic information, leading to biased transformation results, and easily overlooking the true transfer characteristics of remote sensing images, resulting in unstable model training.

pmc-12788058.title: Cost-Effective and High-Throughput WSPRi Sensing System Based on Multi-Monochromatic LEDs and Adaptive Second-Order Fitting Algorithm
pmc-12788058.creator: Chenglong Guo, Jiacong Xiao, Jianchun Zeng, Youjun Zeng, Yi Liu
pmc-12788058.description: Surface Plasmon Resonance imaging (SPRi) is a powerful label-free technique for high-throughput biochemical analysis. Wavelength modulation is particularly suitable for SPRi due to its wide dynamic range and robustness to fabrication tolerances. However, conventional systems relying on tunable filters (e.g., AOTF, LCTF) suffer from high cost, complexity, and limited temporal resolution.

pmc-13196362.title: Genetic Epidemiology of Hepatitis B Virus in Africa: A Review
pmc-13196362.creator: Samson Laribik Dujing, Eugene Dogkotegne Kuugbee, Williams Walana
pmc-13196362.description: Background and AimsHepatitis B virus (HBV) is an enveloped and hepatotoxic virus belonging to the hepadnaviridae family, and it has the potential to cause both acute and chronic hepatitis. HBV remains a major public health threat, particularly in Asia, Africa, and South America, resulting in several deaths even though there is currently a safe vaccine against it.

pmc-13465316.creator: Shuai Shi, Jia Jiao, Jia Zhao, Guoqing Zhang, Xiangnan Li
pmc-13465316.description: BackgroundCarinal reconstruction is the primary surgical intervention for tracheal tumors involving the tracheal carina. pmc-13660029.title: A simple hand-sectioning approach for cellular-resolution imaging of anatomy and gene expression in small developing organs and boundary regions in Arabidopsis
pmc-13660029.creator: Jae-Ung Hwang, Seonghwan Kim, Heejeong Son, June M. Kwak
pmc-13660029.description: BackgroundPrecise characterization of gene expression patterns across temporal, cellular, and tissue-specific contexts is fundamental to understanding plant development and function.
